node.title: DLI zero-fiber mass is bounded by the full primitive-relation polymer majorant
node.statement: For signed kernel relations c with activity 2^(-|supp c|), every relation partitions into disjoint primitive relations. Hence the normalized zero-fiber partition function Z is at most the primitive independence polynomial and therefore at most exp(P), where P is the full primitive activity. The raw full-spectrum signed-shift ledger W_full dominates P, so E_j<=r_j exp(W_full,j). On the official schedule, product_j E_j<=2^100 follows from sum_j W_full,j<=100 log 2+t log(2^256/q). This exact interface replaces the refuted truncated C1' route but does not assert the aggregate full-spectrum budget, C2'', or B-WEAK.
